notes.title: Demo Ver. 0.4.0 Released
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]We are excited to announce the release of [b]Demo Ver. 0.4.0[/b].
The main focus of this update is the [b]complete overhaul of the UI design[/b]. Since the demo launched, UI visuals have been the most common feedback from players. Many pages previously had only plain backgrounds without proper artwork due to early development constraints. We took this issue very seriously and made it our top priority to address.[/p][p]Now, almost all in-game pages have been redesigned and polished, offering a much-improved visual experience. This is the highlight of Version 0.4.0, and we warmly invite you to try out the brand-new UI![/p][p]In addition, we have also made improvements to the [b]save system[/b] and [b]shop interface[/b] interactions for a smoother gameplay experience.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and feedback—we look forward to hearing more from you![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606581/168614527f2b222404b99d1c9bda76c817641144.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606581/3638d5beb672f6b0c6234e29b10a6fe4c8b1c5a0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45606581/c9d497749f1fa2bc9942c895f00cd4840b25910d.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Now Available & Featured in Steam Next Fest June 2025
notes.notes:
[p]To all teachers working tirelessly on the educational frontlines of Gensokyo:[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [b]"A Schoolhouse in Gensokyo" will be part of the June 2025 Steam Next Fest starting June 9 (PT)![/b]
Our free demo is now available — come experience the charm of this unique school in the world of Gensokyo.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]Demo Info[/h2][list][*][p][b]Playtime[/b]: 16 turns (~2–3 hours)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Features[/b]: Core course planning, student growth, basic upgrade systems[/p][/*][*][p][b]Languages[/b]: Simplified Chinese / Japanese [/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Game Overview[/h2][p]Take on the role of [b]Keine Kamishirasawa[/b], a half-beast teacher running a small school in the Human Village.
This is a [b]strategic course-building + school sim[/b] rooted in Gensokyo.[/p][p][b]Key Features[/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Strategic Class Planning[/b]: Place weekly courses to trigger combos[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Interactions[/b]: Talk and gift to Gensokyo residents, unlock side events and items[/p][/*][*][p][b]Regional Influence[/b]: Lessons spread across regions, unlocking new stories and mechanics[/p][/*][*][p][b]Upgrade Paths[/b]: Invest in Neutral, Reformist, or Traditional teaching ideologies to shape your school's path and ending[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h2]Development Roadmap[/h2][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Timeline[/p][/th][th][p]Content[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p][b]June 9–16[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Demo featured in Steam Next Fest[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]August (Target)[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Early Access (EA) launch:
- 3 full chapters of main story
- Full gift system
- Passive teaching items and core mechanics
- Visual & UI improvements[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]During EA[/b][/p][/td][td][p]Continued updates based on feedback, extra stories, Steam Workshop support[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Join the Community[/h2][list][*][p][b]X[/b]: [url="https://x.com/crestruction"]https://x.com/crestruction[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Bilibili: @Crestruction-樱游社  @虚拟游戏制作人DukeFeng[/p][/*][*][p]Steam Discussions: We welcome all suggestions![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thank you to everyone who’s following, playing, and giving feedback. See you at the Next Fest — class is about to begin![/p][p]— The Creator Workgroup[/p][p][/p]
